title: Ms. Rachel & Mr. Aron Host a Kids Place Playdate on SiriusXM
summary: Tune in for music, movement, stories, and songs from Ms. Rachel and Mr. Aron’s new album, “I’m So Happy.”
body_markdown:
Ms. Rachel and Mr. Aron are bringing a special family-friendly playdate to SiriusXM’s[Kids Place (Ch. 134)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/kids-place) this weekend.


[Kids Place (Ch. 134) Family-friendly music & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMsRachelPlaydateKidsPlace)


The one-hour *Ms. Rachel & Mr. Aron’s Kids Place Playdate* premieres Saturday, September 26 at 9am ET and features music from their new album, *I’m So Happy* , along with family favorites from some of their favorite artists and musical friends.


Throughout the special, Ms. Rachel and Mr. Aron share stories behind their songs, encourage kids to sing, move, and play along, and introduce listeners to more music the whole family can enjoy.


### **Ms. Rachel & Mr. Aron’s Kids Place Playdate Schedule**


**Premiere:** Saturday, September 26 at 9am ET


**Encores:**


- Saturday, September 26 at 10pm ET
- Sunday, September 27 at 9am ET
- Sunday, September 27 at 10pm ET


Listen to *Ms. Rachel & Mr. Aron’s Kids Place Playdate* on satellite channel 134 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMsRachelPlaydateKidsPlace) starting Saturday, September 26 at 9am ET, with rebroadcasts throughout the weekend.


### Listen to Kids Place on SiriusXM


On the 24/7 Kids Place channel, hear live hosts, laugh-out-loud calls with real kids, and the best in family-friendly music and entertainment.
